name: An Grianan Theatre
scope: The standing Port Road theatre in Letterkenny. The model uses the cleared 2007 image for the signature glass foyer and entrance, and the mapped outline for the connected auditorium and backstage volumes.
era: Standing 1999 theatre, with the Port Road frontage detailed as photographed in 2007.

originalReview.notes: Exact public-domain original showing the pale walls and white eaves, red framing above the glass and curved entrance.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: The selected exact Qualla original is the unaltered transfer of DevelopedMadness's author-released public-domain photograph. It documents the frontage before the 2014 renovation.
